shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Optional separation for a singular framed tool.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Modal dialogs and elevated menus only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main command in a focused workflow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 36px; padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid #101720; border-radius: 6px; background: #101720; color: #ffffff; font: 700 14px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #27313d; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(94,143,202,.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid #b8c4d0; border-radius: 6px; background: #ffffff; color: #101720; font: 400 14px/1.45 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #657380; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(94,143,202,.22); border-color: #5e8fca; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Textual status with semantic color support.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 28px; padding: 4px 9px; border: 1px solid #acd8c5; border-radius: 999px; background: #e3f4ed; color: #101720; font: 700 12px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: #16845b; }

components.name: Operational Panel
components.description: A singular framed tool with restrained separation.
components.css: .ds-panel { max-width: 360px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #d9e0e8; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: #101720; font: 400 14px/1.45 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 15px; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: #657380; }

narrative.overview: SteamBee should make infrastructure and account state calm, explicit, and easy to operate. Its visual system favors compact information, durable semantics, and local control over spectacle.

rules.name: State before decoration
rules.body: Semantic state and required action always outrank visual embellishment.

rules.name: Borders carry structure
rules.body: Use surface and border hierarchy before introducing elevation.

dos: Keep current account and worker state visible.
Use stable dimensions for controls and status elements.
Expose core settings on narrow screens.
donts: Do not build marketing composition into the app.
Do not nest cards or use decorative color blobs.
Do not rely on color or motion alone.
